race.description: Johnnie Walker Apm 'Whiskey' Memorial Mdn Plate
race.comment: Tricky race to assess with many of these facing the starter for the first time. If the raced brigade NIGHT MARKET (7) is a maiden galloper resuming from a spell after finishing sixth over 1000m at Eagle Farm at the latest appearance on March 21. Fitter for two trials, placing most recently. Ready to open her account. MISHANI ROZAY (6) returned from a spell a week-and-a-half ago when she was in the firing line on the corner before being beaten 4 lengths into eighth over 1000m at Eagle Farm. Finds a more suitable contest and can get the job done. THREE NON BLONDES (10) is a three-year-old filly on debut from the stable of Jason Edwards. By Dubious from Savage Young Blond. Gets in light with the claim and expected to feature. RUSSIAN FANTASY (9) is a filly by Russian Revolution out of Moretti on debut. Has had the benefit of two trials. Betting to hold the key.
